cards.card_text: Jesus adds a side note: circumcision didn't start with Moses but with the patriarchs.
cards.verse_text: But because Moses gave you circumcision, you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)
cards.snippet: …on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)

cards.card_text: God gives Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and his line runs through Isaac and Jacob to Jacob's twelve sons, the patriarchs.
cards.verse_text: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt.
cards.snippet: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt.

cards.card_text: Then Paul lists what belongs to Israel: the adoption as sons, the divine glory, the covenants, the law, the temple worship, the promises and the patriarchs.
cards.verse_text: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God over all, forever worthy of praise!
cards.snippet: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God…

cards.card_text: The patriarchs The priests The kings
cards.verse_text: Regarding the gospel, they are enemies on your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.
cards.snippet: …your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.

cards.card_text: Then Paul explains: Christ has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God's truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs.
cards.verse_text: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God’s truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs,
cards.snippet: …on behalf of God’s truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs,

cards.card_text: The writer says to consider this: even the patriarch Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth of the plunder.
cards.verse_text: Consider how great Melchizedek was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.
cards.snippet: Consider how great Melchizedek was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.
